54.name: Pewter Gym
54._comment: Interior geometry read back from a lane's own WorldMap (data/probe/c+d/world.map, 2026-08-17): a 10x14 room entered on the door mats at (4,13)/(5,13), with row y=0 solid wall and Brock's sprite blocking (5,0) — there is no north map edge here, which is why the parcel quest's 'pilot north' (cross_step) swept the boundary forever instead of walking to Brock. Rock rows run across y=3, y=5, y=7 and y=9 with gaps only at x=4-5 (y=3/y=9) and x=1,3-4,8 (y=5/y=7). The straight climb up x=4 is blocked at (4,5) by the Jr. Trainer, who faces away — the player bumps his back forever without even starting the battle (probe D: 2000 turns, 0 battles, wedged at (4,6)). These waypoints take the east detour around him: up x=4 to y=8, east along the open y=8 row to x=8, north up the x=8 gap to y=4, west along y=4 to x=5, then north through the y=3 gap to Brock's face tile. The last waypoint IS the face tile: the navigator runs out of waypoints there and the agent's default 'a' talks to Brock.

2.name: Pewter City
2._comment: Doors are the map's warp table (read back from wWarpEntries): Gym (16,17)->54, Pokemon Center (13,25)->58, Mart (23,17)->56, Museum (14,7)/(19,5)->52. The old first waypoint (13,25) 'Enter from forest' WAS the Pokemon Center door — every lane walked in and wedged at the counter (evals/cases/pewter-pokecenter-exit.json) — and the old 'Pewter Gym' waypoint (16,11) is open ground north of the building. Layout (emulator BFS from the Route 2 entry): a fence spans y=21 for x<=18 with the gap at x>=19; the Gym block (x 12-17, y 14-17) is fenced on its east side (x=18, y 18-21), so its door is reached from the west: north up x=19, west along y=13, south down x=10, east along y=18.
